reason: B is the better, though still weak, proposal because dilute Ti alloying is more physically plausible than expecting carbon to trigger TWIP/TRIP in a stable BCC refractory alloy, where carbon is more likely to strengthen or form carbides; A’s cited evidence concerns metastable FCC-to-HCP alloys and does not support its mechanism. B remains speculative because Ti grain-boundary segregation and retention of strength and irradiation resistance at 1600 °C are unsupported and must be directly verified.
